inputs.text: This is about more than one conviction. France’s new “psychological subjection” law gives authorities an elastic label they can use against communities they want to bring into line. Father Bernard Domini, the abbot leading the Missionary Family of Notre-Dame, is being made an example of, while the public is being asked to see it as protection. That’s how control gets normalized: officials decide which beliefs are dangerous, then use vague language to make dissent look threatening. Today it’s this community; the precedent could be used against anyone inconvenient.

output.main_topic: France’s “psychological subjection” law and its alleged use to control communities and dissent
subtopics: Father Bernard Domini being made an example of
Potential use of the law against dissenting communities
